title: Wisp configuration
description: Everything Wisp persists, in ~/.config/wisp/wisp.jsonc. Every key is optional: a missing key takes its default, a key of the wrong shape is named in the footer and ignored.

chord.description: Modifiers plus one key, in any order: cmd+shift+d, opt+up, ctrl+opt+. — hyper stands for all four modifiers.

chordSet.description: One chord, or a list of chords that all reach the same action.

$schema.description: Editor hint; Wisp writes ./wisp.schema.json and ignores the key.

notes.description: The notes body face, by family name. Omit or null for the system font.

ui.description: Header, footer, and overlays. Omit or null for the system font.

code.description: `inline code` runs, and the whole body in source view. Omit or null for the system monospace.

fontScale.description: Multiplies every type size, body and chrome. ⌘= / ⌘- step it by 0.1. Clamped to 0.6–2.5 in use.

blur.description: Blurs whatever is behind the panel.

opacity.description: Alpha of the panel's tint, 0–1. 1 is a solid panel; null keeps each theme's tuned value.

monitor.description: primary opens on the menu bar's screen, or wherever a saved position is; pointer on whichever display the cursor is on, with a saved position carried to the same relative spot there.

position.description: Where the panel was last dragged to: its top-left corner in screen points, y growing upward. Written when the panel hides. Omit or null — which Reset Position writes — for the default spot, centred with its top edge 5% down the screen.

peekHold.description: Milliseconds the summon chord must be held before the panel peeks — closing when the chord is let go — instead of pinning. 0 always peeks.

saveIndicator.description: Flashes a dot in the top corner each time the note is written.

smartPaste.description: Pasting onto a blank line turns a tab-separated grid into a pipe table and a run of short plain lines into a bulleted list.

keymap.description: Every shortcut, rebindable. summon is the global chord.

size.description: Spaces per level, 1–16 in use. Ignored under tabs.

motion.description: snappy lands at once and settles, gliding slides, off teleports. Reduce Motion forces off.

blink.description: Fade the caret in and out while idle; false keeps it solid.

panel.description: The remembered panel size in screen points, written when the panel hides.
